creatures.notes: A dawn grazer that carries the old forest song in its antlers. Breed with wheat; brush adults for Dawn Velvet.
creatures.name: Dawn Stag

creatures.notes: A shy dusk forager whose tail marks safe paths. Breed with sweet berries; brush adults for Lantern Down.
creatures.name: Lantern Fox

creatures.notes: A patient wetland gardener with a living shell. Breed with seagrass; brush adults for a naturally shed Mossback Scale.
creatures.name: Mossback

creatures.notes: The remains of a broken fire rite. Its melee strikes briefly ignite; keep water close.
creatures.name: Ashbound

creatures.notes: A grove guardian twisted by a severed ley line. Slow but sturdy; its blows root travellers briefly.
creatures.name: Rootbound

creatures.notes: A marsh hunter concealed among spirit reeds. Fast strikes carry a short poison.
creatures.name: Reed Stalker

creatures.notes: A crystal-field scavenger armored in singing stone. Keep your distance from its heavy shove.
creatures.name: Shardback

creatures.notes: An empty watchman that still guards the ancient roads. Its touch weakens the grip of attackers.
creatures.name: Hollow Sentinel

creatures.notes: A storm-fed spirit with vast veil wings. A bright gathering of motes warns of its gust; cover breaks the attack.
creatures.name: Storm Moth

creatures.notes: A nimble ember spirit. It gathers sparks before a burning bolt; the spell never ignites terrain.
creatures.name: Cinder Imp

creatures.notes: A floating relic that remembers the lost tribes. Its telegraphed chime slows; shelter interrupts the song.
creatures.name: Mourning Bell

creatures.notes: A hunter drawn to tears in the lattice. It closes distance quickly but cannot cross worlds by itself.
creatures.name: Rift Hound

creatures.notes: An eight-legged keeper of broken songs. Its bite slows prey without placing webs or damaging the camp.
creatures.name: Echo Weaver
